description: Complete websites for small and local businesses, built and hosted in about 5 minutes.

interface.longDescription:
Build and host a complete website for your small business, just by describing it in chat. WebZum has built 2,900+ small-business websites. A few details — your business name, what you do, where you are and how customers reach you — become a live, multi-page website in about 5 minutes, for a plumber, restaurant, salon, contractor, clinic, shop or any trade. No existing website or Google listing needed.

Built to avoid where small-business websites usually fail:
• Live, not just code: hosted with SSL at a real URL the moment the build finishes
• Real, not placeholder: your real phone, address and photos of your business when we find them, plus a custom logo, images and a short hero video
• Leads that reach you: every contact-form lead is emailed to you, and a 24/7 AI chatbot answers visitors from your site's own content and sends you their details
• About you, not generic: 3 to 7 pages of original copy based on research into your business and its local market
• Found on Google: local SEO built in — page titles and descriptions, schema.org business markup with hours and service areas, a sitemap and local keyword research
• Found by AI assistants (AEO): every site welcomes AI search crawlers and ships an llms.txt
• Works on phones: mobile-ready pages with one main contact button for the channel your customers use — call, WhatsApp or LINE
• Your language: the whole site written natively in English, Spanish or any other language

Your site, your account: you confirm your email and the site is created in your WebZum account. Sign in at webzum.com any time to edit the site by chat, connect your own domain or launch a Google Search ad.

WebZum can also publish web pages and small web apps you create with ChatGPT at a live, shareable link.

Limits: one business website per conversation; creating a site needs the owner's email; up to 3 builds per email per day.
